qualifier: vitamins A, D and K, with gamma-carboxylation
name: Vitamin A, D and K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation
rationale: All members concern fat-soluble vitamin (retinoid, calciferol, vitamin K) metabolism, response or vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation, distinguishing it from steroid hormone, phosphate/mineralization and visual retinoid-cycle confusables.

qualifier: craniofacial, ear, limb and pharyngeal gland
name: Craniofacial, ear, limb and pharyngeal organ morphogenesis
rationale: Members are mesenchyme-driven morphogenesis of head, face, inner/middle/outer ear, limbs and pharyngeal-derived glands (thymus, thyroid, parathyroid, pituitary), unlike confusables centred on neural plate, HOX and somite patterning.

qualifier: centriole duplication and primary cilium assembly/disassembly
name: Centrosome, centriole duplication and primary cilium regulation
rationale: Members regulate centrosome positioning, MTOC nucleation, centriole duplication/cohesion and basal body/cilium assembly, whereas confusables concern mitotic spindle assembly and orientation.

qualifier: potassium-channel hyperpolarization limiting depolarization
name: Neuronal action potential dampening by potassium-channel hyperpolarization
rationale: Members control resting potential, hyperpolarization and suppression of action potentials and depolarization via TRESK and Ca2+-activated K+ channels, distinct from pacemaker HCN, other K2P/KATP channel and ion-pump confusables.

qualifier: vesicle docking, priming and calcium-triggered exocytosis
name: Synaptic vesicle docking, priming and calcium-triggered neurotransmitter release
rationale: Members cover the release cycle of monoamine, acetylcholine and glutamate vesicles through docking, SNARE assembly, priming and Ca2+-dependent fusion, unlike confusables on vesicle recycling/endocytosis and presynaptic calcium or GABA/glutamate secretion control.

qualifier: ARF-MDM2 control and G1/G2 checkpoint arrest
name: p53 regulation and DNA damage-induced G1/G2 checkpoint arrest
rationale: Members concern p53 expression, activation, degradation and ARF defects plus radiation-induced G1/G2 checkpoint arrest (p21, CDC25A, GTSE1), whereas confusables emphasise p53-driven apoptosis, p16-dependent senescence or AKT signalling.

qualifier: p75NTR and dependence receptors
name: p75 neurotrophin receptor and dependence-receptor apoptotic signalling
rationale: Members describe p75NTR ligand binding, proteolysis and death/survival effectors (NRIF, NRAGE, NADE, ceramide, NF-kB) and ligand-free dependence-receptor caspase activation, unlike TRK survival and axon-growth confusables.

qualifier: neutrophil degranulation and complement receptor signalling
name: Myeloid inflammatory activation with neutrophil degranulation
rationale: Members share myeloid/monocyte inflammatory activation centred on neutrophil degranulation and complement receptor signalling, as opposed to respiratory burst, formyl-peptide chemotaxis or microbial killing confusables.

qualifier: collagen crosslinking and elastic fibre assembly
name: Collagen synthesis, fibril crosslinking and elastic fibre assembly
rationale: Members concern collagen biosynthesis, fibril organization and crosslinking and elastic fibre assembly, distinguishing from matrix degradation and basement membrane/integrin confusables.

qualifier: action potential phases and conduction system coupling
name: Cardiac action potential phases and His-Purkinje conduction
rationale: Members cover nodal, atrial and ventricular action potential phases, the K+/HCN channels shaping them and gap-junction conduction through the His-Purkinje system, unlike contraction, calcium handling and T-tubule confusables.

qualifier: telomerase action with capping and recombination suppression
name: Telomere maintenance by telomerase, capping and recombination suppression
rationale: Members concern telomerase recruitment and extension together with telomere packaging, capping and ATRX/DAXX suppression of recombination, unlike confusables on C-strand replication, ALT recombination or rRNA modification.

qualifier: ubiquitin-proteasome degradation and ERAD
name: Misfolded protein quality control via ubiquitin-proteasome and ERAD
rationale: Members concern recognition and ubiquitin-dependent proteasomal or ER-associated degradation of misfolded proteins (plus reticulophagy), unlike aggrephagy/chaperone-mediated autophagy and deubiquitinase confusables.

qualifier: UV-A and blue light response
name: Melanocyte pigmentation response to UV-A and blue light
rationale: Members link melanocyte proliferation and MITF-driven pigment/secondary metabolite synthesis to UV-A and blue light, distinct from melanosome biogenesis and non-pigmentation MITF target confusables.

qualifier: synthesis, transport and receptor subtypes
name: Serotonin synthesis, transport and receptor signalling
rationale: Every member concerns serotonin biosynthesis, secretion, uptake or its receptor signalling branches, distinguishing from muscarinic, adenosine and histamine confusables.

qualifier: immunoglobulin-superfamily L1/DSCAM receptors, self-avoidance and fasciculation
name: L1/DSCAM-family neuronal adhesion and dendrite self-avoidance
rationale: Members concern Ig-superfamily neuronal adhesion molecules (L1, CHL1, DSCAM, sidekick, nectins) mediating fasciculation, self-avoidance, remodelling and pruning, unlike the semaphorin, netrin and SLIT-ROBO axon guidance confusables.

qualifier: RUNX1 and TAL1-GFI1B transcriptional control
name: Transcriptional control of erythroid and megakaryocyte differentiation
rationale: Members concern erythrocyte and megakaryocyte/platelet differentiation and its transcriptional regulators, distinguishing from myeloid progenitor/granulopoiesis and erythrocyte maturation/oxygen transport confusables.

qualifier: serotonin, muscarinic and adenosine receptors
name: cAMP regulation by serotonin, muscarinic and adenosine receptors
rationale: Members are serotonin, muscarinic and adenosine/purinergic receptor signalling coupled to adenylate cyclase, PLC and PDE1-mediated cAMP breakdown, unlike serotonin metabolism, adrenergic, nicotinic and tachykinin confusables.

qualifier: carboxylates, monocarboxylates and carnitine
name: Solute carrier transport of carboxylates, monocarboxylates and carnitine
rationale: Members concern SLC-mediated transport of lactate/pyruvate, di- and tricarboxylates, carnitine and organic ions and their transporter diseases, unlike creatine, fatty acid, cationic amino acid and choline confusables.

qualifier: Cajal body trafficking and telomere recruitment
name: Telomerase assembly, Cajal body trafficking and telomere recruitment
rationale: Members concern telomerase RNA folding, holoenzyme assembly, Cajal body localization and recruitment to telomeres for extension, unlike telomere protection, snoRNP and chaperonin confusables.

qualifier: nephric duct, ureteric bud and nephron tubules
name: Nephric duct, ureteric bud and nephron tubule development
rationale: Members cover intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct, ureteric bud branching and nephron/tubule morphogenesis, distinct from glomerular vasculature and other branching gland confusables.

core: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface signature
qualifier: resting state with CD1 lipid antigen presentation
name: Monocyte and resting dendritic cell surface CD1 lipid presentation
rationale: Members are monocyte and resting dendritic cell surface/receptor signatures including CD1 lipid antigen presentation, unlike activated DC, MHC-TLR7 and neutrophil confusables.

qualifier: de novo and ER folding, refolding
name: Chaperone-assisted de novo protein folding and refolding
rationale: Members concern ATP-dependent chaperone folding, refolding and oligomer assembly and suppression of inclusion bodies, unlike CCT/TRiC actin-tubulin folding, heat shock response and aggrephagy confusables.

qualifier: defensins, metal sequestration and mucosal killing
name: Mucosal antimicrobial defence by defensins and metal sequestration
rationale: Members concern antimicrobial peptides (alpha/beta defensins), metal sequestration and direct killing or lysis of bacteria and fungi at mucosa, unlike respiratory burst and antimicrobial peptide biosynthesis confusables.

qualifier: basement membrane, laminin-integrin and hemidesmosome adhesion
name: Collagen, basement membrane and integrin-laminin adhesion assembly
rationale: Members cover collagen, elastic fibre, fibronectin and basement membrane assembly plus laminin/integrin, hemidesmosome and dystroglycan anchoring, beyond the purely collagen/elastic or ECM-module confusables.

qualifier: Pol I/III elongation, termination and pre-rRNA cleavage
name: RNA polymerase I/III elongation, termination and pre-rRNA cleavage
rationale: Members concern elongation and termination of RNA polymerase I and III transcription and early pre-rRNA endonucleolytic cleavages, unlike initiation, tRNA/snRNA transcription and rDNA regulation confusables.
